svg.title: Prompt engineering, chain of thought, and schema-guided reasoning compared
svg.desc: Four rows compare output form, control mechanism, auditability, and error handling across three approaches. Schema-guided reasoning is the focus column because constrained decoding blocks invalid structure before generation finishes; the other two only let a reader or parser detect the problem afterward.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Constrained decoding is the only one that blocks invalid structure before generation.
